image_qa.note: The vape reference, return and warranty tool, and structured-data trust update use text, tables, forms and existing design components. No product, medical, cultivar, affiliate, stock or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Stem Cell CBG had the only supported position 4–20 page signal, with 13 impressions, one click, and position 5.3, and it was materially expanded on October 8. Remaining position 4–20 rows had only one to seven impressions, so no Data-led item was justified; those tiny samples and the isolated Oklahoma-law click were deliberately ignored. Today's work strengthens a distinct vape-product authority gap, a fresh after-sale accessory workflow, and technical trust rather than chasing another thin query variation.

authority.action: Rebuilt the thin vape page into a citation-worthy oil, source, lot, hardware, health, storage and disposal reference using current CDC, FDA, CPSC and Poison Control sources; connected it reciprocally to battery, comparison and disposal paths; and added a sitewide structured-data identity gate. No outreach was sent and no new outreach target was logged because strengthening the site's own product-format cluster was the higher-value authority action.
